_about: The built-in category tree: the one place to edit it. scripts/build_category_migration.py turns this file into
supabase/migrations/20261125000000_category_redesign.sql; tests/db/test_schema_extras.py checks the database against it.
fields: the shared field library. A category's fields list names a library key ("model"), or a library key with
overrides ({"key": "format", "options": [...]}; only options and show_if may be overridden), or a field used by
that category alone ({"key", "label", "type", ...}). A key used by two or more categories must be in the library.
Field keys: key, label, type (text|number|boolean|choice), options (choice only), scope ("product": a fact about the
product, not your copy), show_if ({"key", "equals"}: show only when that field has that value).
renamed_from: the old built-in name of a row kept in place, so its items keep their link.

categories.name: Video Games
categories.description: Video games and the hardware to play them: games, consoles, controllers and accessories. Not board or card games (Games & Puzzles) or game-themed figures (Toys › Figures).

children.name: Games
children.description: Physical video games: cartridges, discs, boxed PC games and collector's editions (Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Pokémon Red). Not consoles (Consoles) or strategy guides (Books).

children.name: Consoles
children.description: Game consoles and handhelds, one item per console (Switch OLED, Game Boy Pocket, PS2 Slim); the hardware variant goes in Model. Not controllers (Controllers) or cases and chargers (Accessories).

children.name: Controllers
children.description: Gamepads, joysticks and motion controllers (Joy-Con, DualSense, GameCube controller, Wii Remote). Not cases, chargers or other add-ons (Accessories).

children.name: Accessories
children.description: Add-ons for game hardware: cases, chargers, docks, memory cards, cables, steering wheels (Switch carrying case, N64 Rumble Pak). Not controllers (Controllers) or general bags (Bags & Cases).

categories.name: Movies & TV
categories.description: Movies and TV shows on physical media. Not soundtracks (Music › Albums), posters (Home Decor › Wall art & Posters) or merchandise, which goes by what it is (a figure is Toys › Figures).

children.name: Discs
children.description: Movies and TV on disc: 4K UHD, Blu-ray, DVD and HD DVD, steelbooks and box sets included (Spirited Away Blu-ray, The Office complete series). Not tapes (VHS & tapes) or video game discs (Video Games › Games).

children.name: VHS & tapes
children.description: Movies and TV on tape: VHS, Betamax and ex-rental tapes (a Disney black diamond VHS). Not audio cassettes (Music › Albums) or discs (Discs).

categories.name: Books
categories.description: Books of every kind: novels, nonfiction, cookbooks, art books, strategy guides. A book that fits no child stays here. Not sheet music or lesson books (Music › Sheet music & lesson books) or photo albums (Family photos & documents › Photos & albums).

children.name: Manga
children.description: Japanese comics and light novels in print, one item per volume (One Piece vol. 1, Spy x Family). Not Western comics (Comics & graphic novels).

children.name: Comics & graphic novels
children.description: Comic issues, trade paperbacks and graphic novels (Watchmen, Amazing Spider-Man #300, a Calvin and Hobbes collection). Not manga (Manga) or picture books (Children's books).

children.name: Children's books
children.description: Picture books, board books and early readers (The Very Hungry Caterpillar, Dr. Seuss). Not young-adult novels (Books) or comics (Comics & graphic novels).

children.name: Textbooks
children.description: Books bought for a class, with the course and term (Database System Concepts for CS 452). Not general nonfiction (Books) or instrument lesson books (Music › Sheet music & lesson books).

categories.name: Music
categories.description: Recorded music and making music: albums, instruments, their gear, and sheet music. Not band posters (Home Decor › Wall art & Posters), concert tickets (Memorabilia & Keepsakes › Tickets & programs) or headphones and speakers (Electronics › Audio).

children.name: Albums
children.description: Recorded music on a physical format: vinyl records, CDs and cassettes (Abbey Road on vinyl, a Taylor Swift CD). Not concert films or music videos (Movies & TV › Discs).

children.name: Instruments
children.description: Musical instruments (trumpet, guitar, keyboard, ukulele). Not tuners, stands, amps or cases (Instrument gear & accessories) or toy instruments (Toys).

children.name: Instrument gear & accessories
children.description: Gear for playing an instrument: tuners, metronomes, stands, amps, pedals, straps, mouthpieces and instrument cases. Not the instrument itself (Instruments) or headphones and speakers (Electronics › Audio).

children.name: Sheet music & lesson books
children.description: Sheet music, method books and songbooks for an instrument, for lessons or for fun (an Essential Elements trumpet book, a Star Wars songbook for trumpet). Not textbooks for a class (Books › Textbooks) or albums (Albums).

categories.name: Games & Puzzles
categories.description: Games played seated at a table, and puzzles: board games, card games, sealed trading card products, jigsaw puzzles and game accessories. Not video games (Video Games) or games played standing or outdoors like cornhole (Sports & outdoors › Lawn & yard games).

children.name: Board games
children.description: Board games and their expansions, one item per box (Catan, Ticket to Ride: Europe, Pandemic: On the Brink). Not games played with only cards (Card games) or jigsaw puzzles (Puzzles).

children.name: Card games
children.description: Games played with their own deck, and standard playing cards (Uno, Exploding Kittens, Phase 10, a deck of Bicycle cards). Not collectible card products (Trading card games).

children.name: Trading card games
children.description: Sealed trading card game product: booster packs and boxes, pre-constructed decks, tins and bundles (a Pokémon booster box, a Magic: The Gathering starter deck). Not single cards, which are not tracked, or sleeves, playmats and deck boxes (Game accessories).

children.name: Puzzles
children.description: Jigsaw puzzles and 3D puzzles (a 1000-piece Ravensburger, a Wrebbit 3D castle). Not Rubik's cubes and other twisty toys (Toys › Classic toys).

children.name: Game accessories
children.description: Things you play table games with: dice, playmats, card sleeves, deck boxes, storage tins and card shufflers. Not video game add-ons (Video Games › Accessories).

categories.name: Toys
categories.description: Toys of every kind: building sets, figures, plush, vehicles, dolls, battle, electronic, classic and creative toys. Not ride-ons, kites or water guns (Sports & outdoors › Outdoor play), board games (Games & Puzzles) or model kits you build and paint (Craft & hobby › Model kits & miniatures).

children.name: Building sets
children.description: Construction sets with pieces and a set number (LEGO, Mega Bloks, K'NEX, Lincoln Logs). Not plastic model kits (Craft & hobby › Model kits & miniatures).

children.name: Figures
children.description: Action figures, collectible and vinyl figures, statues and amiibo (Funko Pop, Nendoroid, Star Wars Black Series). Not dolls (Dolls & playsets) or decorative figurines like porcelain (Home Decor › Decorative objects).

children.name: Plush
children.description: Stuffed animals and plush toys (Squishmallows, Build-A-Bear, Pokémon plush). Not throw pillows (Home Decor › Rugs, curtains & cushions).

children.name: Vehicles
children.description: Toy cars, trains, planes and remote-control vehicles (Hot Wheels, Matchbox, a Thomas train set, an RC car). Not built plastic models (Craft & hobby › Model kits & miniatures) or ride-on toys (Sports & outdoors › Outdoor play).

children.name: Dolls & playsets
children.description: Dolls and the worlds they play in: fashion dolls, dollhouses, playsets and play shops (Barbie, American Girl, a Little People playset, a play storefront). Not action figures (Figures).

children.name: Battle toys
children.description: Spinning-top and battle toys and toy weapons (Beyblade, Bakugan, Nerf, play swords). Not outdoor ride-ons (Sports & outdoors › Outdoor play), collectible figures (Figures) or display replicas (Memorabilia & Keepsakes › Props & replicas).

children.name: Electronic toys
children.description: Battery-powered and electronic toys (Tamagotchi, Furby, Tiger handhelds, Teddy Ruxpin, View-Master). Not game consoles (Video Games › Consoles) or remote-control cars (Vehicles).

children.name: Classic toys
children.description: Simple timeless toys (yo-yo, Slinky, Rubik's cube, Magic 8-Ball, jacks). Not battle tops like Beyblade (Battle toys) or jigsaw puzzles (Games & Puzzles › Puzzles).

children.name: Creative toys
children.description: Toys for making and drawing (Play-Doh, Lite-Brite, Etch A Sketch, Spirograph). Not real art supplies (Craft & hobby › Art supplies) or building sets (Building sets).

categories.name: Memorabilia & Keepsakes
categories.description: Things kept for what they remember, with no other function: signed photos, autographs, pins, tickets, props and replicas, souvenirs. Not things with a use, which go by what they are (a signed poster is Home Decor › Wall art & Posters, a souvenir mug is Kitchen › Drinkware), or heirlooms, which also go by what they are.

children.name: Pins, buttons & patches
children.description: Enamel pins, buttons, badges and embroidered patches (Disney trading pins, scout patches). Not jewelry (Clothing & Linens › Jewelry & watches).

children.name: Tickets & programs
children.description: Ticket stubs, event programs, playbills, passes and wristbands (an Eras Tour ticket, a Broadway playbill). Not posters (Home Decor › Wall art & Posters).

children.name: Props & replicas
children.description: Display replicas and costume props (an anime katana, the Master Sword, a lightsaber, a replica helmet). Not toy weapons for play (Toys › Battle toys) or figures (Toys › Figures).

categories.name: Coins & Currency
categories.description: Coins, paper money, tokens, medals and stamps, one item per piece. Not a coin album or binder: that is a collection of coin items.

children.name: Coins
children.description: Circulating, commemorative and bullion coins (a 1964 Kennedy half dollar, a state quarter, a silver eagle). Not tokens or medals (Tokens & medals).

children.name: Paper money
children.description: Banknotes, US and foreign (a $2 bill, a star note, an old peso). Not stamps (Stamps).

children.name: Tokens & medals
children.description: Tokens, commemorative medals and medallions (arcade tokens, transit tokens, a pressed penny, a challenge coin). Not legal-tender coins (Coins).

children.name: Stamps
children.description: Postage stamps, sheets and first-day covers. Not letters or postcards kept for what they say (Family photos & documents › Documents & letters).

categories.name: Home Decor
categories.description: Things that decorate a room: wall art, frames, candles, decorative objects, seasonal decorations, rugs, curtains and cushions. Not furniture (Furniture) or bedding and blankets (Clothing & Linens).

children.name: Wall art & Posters
children.description: Things that hang on a wall to be looked at: posters, prints, paintings, canvases and tapestries, signed or numbered ones included (a Studio Ghibli poster, a signed concert poster). Not empty frames (Frames & photo displays) or a quilt hung on the wall (Clothing & Linens › Blankets, throws & quilts).

children.name: Frames & photo displays
children.description: Picture frames, digital frames, shadow boxes and display cases. Not the art or photo inside, which is its own item (Wall art & Posters, Family photos & documents › Photos & albums).

children.name: Candles & Fragrance
children.description: Candles, wax melts, diffusers and room sprays (a Bath & Body Works 3-wick). Not candle holders (Decorative objects).

children.name: Decorative objects
children.description: Ornamental pieces for a shelf or table: vases, figurines, lamps, clocks, bookends, snow globes. Not collectible figures (Toys › Figures) or holiday-only decorations (Seasonal).

children.name: Seasonal
children.description: Decorations for a holiday or season, scarecrows included (Christmas ornaments, Halloween decor, a nativity set). Decorations only: not holiday mugs or dishes (Kitchen) or holiday sweaters (Clothing & Linens › Clothing).

children.name: Rugs, curtains & cushions
children.description: Rugs, mats, curtains and throw pillows. Not blankets and throws (Clothing & Linens › Blankets, throws & quilts) or bed pillows and sheets (Clothing & Linens › Bedding).

categories.name: Furniture
categories.description: Furniture, one item per piece: seating, tables and desks, storage and shelving, bedroom furniture. Not lamps and decorative pieces (Home Decor › Decorative objects) or bedding (Clothing & Linens › Bedding).

children.name: Seating
children.description: Chairs, sofas, stools, benches, recliners and bean bags (a gaming chair, a rocking chair). Not cushions (Home Decor › Rugs, curtains & cushions).

children.name: Tables & desks
children.description: Dining, coffee, side and folding tables, and desks. Not shelving (Storage & shelving).

children.name: Storage & shelving
children.description: Bookcases, shelves, cabinets, TV stands and cube organizers. Not dressers and nightstands (Bedroom) or small boxes and bins (Kitchen › Containers & storage, Tools › Tool storage & accessories).

children.name: Bedroom
children.description: Beds, bed frames, mattresses, dressers, nightstands and wardrobes. Not bedding (Clothing & Linens › Bedding).

categories.name: Kitchen
categories.description: Things for cooking, eating, drinking and storing food: appliances, cookware, utensils, drinkware, dishes, snack ware and containers. Not dish towels or table linens (Clothing & Linens).

children.name: Appliances
children.description: Kitchen appliances, small and large (a KitchenAid mixer, an Instant Pot, a toaster, a coffee maker, a popcorn machine). Not TVs or speakers (Electronics).

children.name: Cookware & bakeware
children.description: Pots, pans, baking sheets, cake pans, casserole dishes and mixing bowls. Not serving bowls and plates (Dishes & serveware).

children.name: Utensils & cutlery
children.description: Silverware, knives, spatulas, whisks, measuring cups and gadgets (a knife block set, a garlic press). Not workshop tools (Tools › Hand tools).

children.name: Drinkware
children.description: Mugs, cups, glasses, tumblers, water bottles and pitchers, souvenir and themed cups included (a Disney mug, a movie-theater collector cup). Not popcorn buckets (Popcorn & snack ware) or plates and bowls (Dishes & serveware).

children.name: Dishes & serveware
children.description: Plates, bowls, platters, serving bowls, gravy boats and cake stands. Not mixing bowls (Cookware & bakeware) or popcorn bowls (Popcorn & snack ware).

children.name: Popcorn & snack ware
children.description: Popcorn bowls, popcorn tins, movie-theater popcorn buckets, candy dishes and chip-and-dip sets. Not other tins like a cookie tin (Containers & storage) or a popcorn machine (Appliances).

children.name: Containers & storage
children.description: Lidded food storage, canisters, jars, bread bins, spice and fruit racks, and tins other than popcorn tins (a cookie tin). Not popcorn tins (Popcorn & snack ware).

categories.name: Bags & Cases
categories.description: General bags and luggage: backpacks, purses, handbags, wallets, suitcases, duffels and tote bags. Not a case made for one kind of thing, which stays with it (a Switch case is Video Games › Accessories, a trumpet case is Music › Instrument gear & accessories, a camera bag is Electronics › Cameras & photography).

categories.name: Clothing & Linens
categories.description: Things you wear and household textiles: clothing, shoes, jewelry and watches, bedding, blankets, towels and table linens. Not rugs, curtains or cushions (Home Decor › Rugs, curtains & cushions).

children.name: Clothing
children.description: Clothes, hats, scarves, gloves, costumes and jerseys (a signed jersey goes here, with Signed by filled in). Not shoes (Shoes) or jewelry (Jewelry & watches).

children.name: Shoes
children.description: Shoes, boots, sneakers, sandals and slippers. Not socks (Clothing).

children.name: Jewelry & watches
children.description: Rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings and watches. Not pins and patches (Memorabilia & Keepsakes › Pins, buttons & patches) or smartwatches (Electronics › Phones & wearables).

children.name: Bedding
children.description: The layers made for a bed: sheets, pillowcases, comforters, duvets and covers, mattress pads and bed pillows. Not blankets, throws or quilts (Blankets, throws & quilts) or the bed itself (Furniture › Bedroom).

children.name: Blankets, throws & quilts
children.description: Anything blanket-like, wherever it is used: quilts, throws, fleece blankets, afghans, picnic blankets, a quilt hung on the wall (Grandma's quilt). Not sheets or comforters (Bedding).

children.name: Towels & washcloths
children.description: Bath, hand, beach and kitchen towels and washcloths: anything that dries or cleans you or a dish. Not tablecloths or napkins (Table linens).

children.name: Table linens
children.description: Tablecloths, cloth napkins, placemats and table runners. Not dish towels (Towels & washcloths).

categories.name: Tools
categories.description: Tools for building, fixing and yard work, one item per tool; a tool set is an item that contains its tools. Not kitchen utensils (Kitchen › Utensils & cutlery) or craft supplies (Craft & hobby).

children.name: Hand tools
children.description: Tools without a motor: hammers, screwdrivers, wrenches, pliers, saws, tape measures and garden hand tools. Not power tools (Power tools).

children.name: Power tools
children.description: Corded and cordless power tools (a DeWalt drill, a circular saw, a leaf blower, a sander). Not kitchen appliances (Kitchen › Appliances).

children.name: Tool storage & accessories
children.description: Toolboxes, tool bags and chests, pegboards, drill bits, blades, and batteries and chargers for tools. Not general bags (Bags & Cases).

categories.name: Electronics
categories.description: Electronic devices and their accessories: computers, phones, audio, cameras, TVs, cables and smart home. Not game consoles and controllers (Video Games), electronic toys (Toys › Electronic toys) or kitchen appliances (Kitchen › Appliances).

children.name: Computers & tablets
children.description: Laptops, desktops, tablets, e-readers, monitors, keyboards and mice (a MacBook Air, an iPad, a Kindle). Not phones (Phones & wearables).

children.name: Phones & wearables
children.description: Phones, smartwatches and fitness trackers (an iPhone, an Apple Watch, a Fitbit). Not regular watches (Clothing & Linens › Jewelry & watches).

children.name: Audio
children.description: Headphones, earbuds, speakers, radios, turntables, CD and MP3 players, iPods and stereos. Not albums (Music › Albums) or instrument amps (Music › Instrument gear & accessories).

children.name: Cameras & photography
children.description: Cameras, lenses, tripods, flashes and camera bags, film cameras included (a Polaroid, a Canon DSLR, a GoPro). Not the photos themselves (Family photos & documents › Photos & albums) or picture frames (Home Decor › Frames & photo displays).

children.name: TVs & home theater
children.description: TVs, projectors, soundbars, receivers, streaming boxes and disc players (a Roku, a Blu-ray player). Not game consoles (Video Games › Consoles).

children.name: Cables, chargers & accessories
children.description: Cables, chargers, adapters, power banks, hubs, surge protectors and memory cards. Not game console add-ons (Video Games › Accessories) or tool batteries (Tools › Tool storage & accessories).

children.name: Smart home
children.description: Smart speakers and displays, bulbs, plugs, cameras, doorbells and thermostats (an Echo Dot, a Ring doorbell). Not ordinary lamps (Home Decor › Decorative objects).

categories.name: Sports & outdoors
categories.description: Sports gear and things used outdoors: sports equipment, camping and hiking, fishing, lawn and yard games, outdoor play. Not sportswear (Clothing & Linens › Clothing) or games played seated at a table (Games & Puzzles).

children.name: Sports equipment
children.description: Balls, bats, gloves, rackets, clubs, weights, yoga mats, skates, bikes and helmets (a signed baseball goes here, with Signed by filled in). Not jerseys (Clothing & Linens › Clothing) or yard games (Lawn & yard games).

children.name: Camping & hiking
children.description: Tents, sleeping bags, backpacking gear, camp stoves, lanterns, coolers and trekking poles. Not everyday backpacks (Bags & Cases).

children.name: Fishing
children.description: Rods, reels, tackle boxes, lures and nets. Not coolers and camp gear (Camping & hiking).

children.name: Lawn & yard games
children.description: Games played standing or outdoors: cornhole, Kan Jam, Spikeball, ladder toss, croquet, bocce. Not games played seated at a table (Games & Puzzles) or kids' outdoor toys (Outdoor play).

children.name: Outdoor play
children.description: Kids' outdoor toys: ride-ons, kites, water guns, bubbles, sidewalk chalk and sandbox toys. Not lawn games (Lawn & yard games) or bikes (Sports equipment).

categories.name: Craft & hobby
categories.description: Supplies and kits for making things: sewing, yarn and fabric, art supplies, model kits and miniatures. Not finished art (Home Decor › Wall art & Posters) or kids' creative toys like Play-Doh (Toys › Creative toys).

children.name: Sewing, yarn & fabric
children.description: Sewing machines, yarn, fabric, thread, knitting needles, crochet hooks and patterns. Not finished quilts (Clothing & Linens › Blankets, throws & quilts).

children.name: Art supplies
children.description: Paints, brushes, markers, pencils, sketchbooks, blank canvases, easels and cutting machines like a Cricut. Not finished paintings (Home Decor › Wall art & Posters).

children.name: Model kits & miniatures
children.description: Plastic and wood model kits and tabletop miniatures, built or not (a Gundam kit, a Revell car model, Warhammer miniatures). Not LEGO and other building sets (Toys › Building sets).

categories.name: Family photos & documents
categories.description: Family photos and papers kept for their memories: prints, albums, letters, cards and certificates. Not framed art (Home Decor › Wall art & Posters). Heirlooms are not a category: Grandma's quilt is a quilt (Clothing & Linens › Blankets, throws & quilts), with its giver and the Inherited occasion.

children.name: Photos & albums
children.description: Printed photos, photo albums, scrapbooks, slides and negatives (Grandma's wedding album). Not empty frames (Home Decor › Frames & photo displays).

children.name: Documents & letters
children.description: Letters, cards, certificates, diaries, handwritten recipes, report cards and family records. Not books (Books) or stamps (Coins & Currency › Stamps).

categories.name: Other
categories.description: The escape hatch, for anything that fits no other category. Check the others first: most things have a home.
